> I followed your suggestion @bobylito -> we only have items now

I was wondering this too. Do you think there was a usecase for having both? The only one I can think of is displaying the currently selected values along with the searchable ones but that's already doable via currentRefinement.

Showing both facet results from the main search AND facet result from facet search does not make sense to me. So we are aligned I guess here. (thx @bobylito)
